intent: TEST for TelemetryRecord at src/main/java/com/pulsestream/telemetry/ledger/domain/TelemetryRecord.java. JUnit 5 + AssertJ (+ Mockito, reactor-test StepVerifier for reactive code); cover every invariant and behavior below, including failure cases, using only the pinned surfaces of collaborators. Unit under test: Telemetry Event Ledger aggregate root (append-only). Immutable record TelemetryRecord(UUID id, String deviceId, String metric, double value, Instant tDevice, Instant tIngress, String validationStatus, int revision, UUID supersedesId). Invariants: revision >= 0; revision 0 iff supersedesId null; non-blank strings, non-null id/instants/status. Static original(deviceId, metric, value, tDevice, tIngress, validationStatus) creates revision 0 with random UUID. TelemetryRecord reviseWith(double value, Instant tIngress, String validationStatus) returns a NEW record: new UUID, same deviceId/metric/tDevice, revision+1, supersedesId = this.id. No mutators: corrections append revisions, never alter history.
